_about: Session workout icons: one per session, chosen for its main exercise, tinted with its modality's colour on every client. An archetype or an exercise names one with `icon:`; src/session_icon.py resolves a session's (archetype, then lead exercise, then `category_defaults`) and every client falls back to its modality icon when a session has none. tools/icons/gen_workout_icons.py draws each id for iOS, the Apple Watch, the widgets, Garmin and the web from tools/icons/workout_glyphs.py; `fallback` is the icon a platform without the asset draws instead.
